character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A highly detailed, full-body pixel art character sprite of the 'Assassino' (Rogue/Assassin) class, inspired by the top-center figure in the character selection screen. The character stands in an agile, menacing battle-ready stance against a solid, neutral grey background. The sprite maintains the 16-bit to 32-bit retro JRPG aesthetic with crisp outlines and detailed pixel shading. The assassin is clad in dark charcoal-grey and black leather armor, fitted with tactical belts, silver buckles, and pouches around the waist and chest. A deep hooded cowl conceals the upper face, revealing only two piercing, glowing red eyes shining from beneath the shadow of the hood. A dark crimson cloth mask covers the lower face. In each hand, the rogue wields a pair of sharp, serrated steel daggers with dark hilts, held in a dual-wield combat grip. The character has a lean, athletic build with proportions consistent with classic fantasy RPG sprites. Clean pixel art execution with precise dithering and edge highlighting to emphasize the dark textures and lethal silhouette.
